selection: Final PPO model per skill after development; no selection on reserved cases
evaluation: One attempt per reserved seed; all outcomes retained; publish and verify freeze before use
orchestration: Auditable scripted play/role/option hierarchy; low-level motor/release policies learned; previous frozen continuous manager unchanged
boundaries: Stationary scripted teammate pass server for receive/redirect
Stationary clearance obstacle; no moving adversarial clearance claim
No official rule, hardware, or complete live ROS-graph qualification

success_contracts.receive: Actual teammate kick, 0.5s uninterrupted mouth contact at every5ms sample, relative ball/robot speed<0.2m/s and ball speed<0.25m/s at every20ms endpoint; no receiver kick
success_contracts.redirect: Actual teammate kick followed by exactly one receiver mouth kick within0.15s of first measured mouth contact, then whole-ball crossing inside opponent goal; no catch-and-hold handoff
success_contracts.clear: Loose own-third ball, >=0.4s stable possession before exactly one kick, actual ball crossing canonical x=-1.0 with signed outlet y in[0.8,2.2]m, no opponent touch or own goal
